City opens new central library

City council opened the new central library on Thursday after a four-year building project that cost four million dollars. The building includes a children's floor, a quiet reading room, and computers for public use.

The mayor said the library will stay open seven days a week and that staff have already registered two thousand new cardholders. Neighbors gathered on the steps to hear the first story hour under the glass roof.

Construction finished two weeks ahead of schedule. The next phase adds a rooftop garden and a small performance space for local musicians and school groups.
